dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: Are researchers all this careless nowadays...

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: Yes, and you want to know why? It's because there's this researcher from Sumeru running around spreading false histories!

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: I don't know what school of reasoning he's from, but whatever it is, he's just spinning out fantasies and distortions!

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: He doesn't seem all that fond of verifying anything, but oh, he's very fascinated with non-existent hypotheses and stories, that's for sure! He's giving me a real headache...

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: I only hope that people aren't taken in by his words and forget Sangonomiya Shrine's real history...

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: See you. I just hope people don't misunderstand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's this true history that you speak of all about?

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: The truth is that the very first shrine on Watatsumi Island is not here at Sangonomiya Shrine. It's actually to the west of the island, where the Statue of The Seven is now.

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: After Watatsumi Omikami was slain by the Electro Archon, Sangonomiya Shrine became our sanctuary where we worship Watatsumi Omikami.

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: A long time ago, when our ancestors were still suffering deep beneath the waves, it was Watatsumi Omikami who defeated the Dragonheir of the Depths and brought them to the surface where the sun shone...

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: The great coral above Sangonomiya Shrine was a gift given by Watatsumi Omikami from its own body, and thus did it gain its name.

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: I remember Her Excellency saying that human wisdom is like a pearl, and that its shine will withstand the test of time.

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: You know what? Take this with you.
